baseline_needed: gsplat on the same deblurnerf-real scenes (cake, caps, tools) with identical args; no shared baseline exists. Paper's comparison row is Mip-Splatting: cake 21.75, caps 21.62, tools 23.80.
notes: Per-scene methods are the official config_real_<scene>.yaml groups (ss_dofgs/variants.py): cake -> dofgs (band_limit true, lambda_mk 0.002), caps -> dofgs-nobl (band_limit false: no Mip 3D filter, plain opacity reset; lambda_mk 0.001), tools -> dofgs-bl-m001 (band_limit true, lambda_mk 0.001); lambda_reg = 0.1 lambda_mk. Other scenes: daisy -> dofgs; cisco, sausage, seal -> dofgs-bl-m001; cupcake, cups -> dofgs-nobl. Paper protocol is 40k iterations; headline = final 40k state (a 15k checkpoint may be reported only as a labelled diagnostic). tools needs its 4 missing COLMAP sparse files first (Drive rate limit); if unavailable, run cake+caps and report as a subset. First dofgs job JIT-compiles the DOF CUDA kernel.
